evidence.reason: The fixture creates commits without disabling inherited `commit.gpgSign`. If a developer or CI environment has `commit.gpgSign=true`, Git attempts to sign the fixture commit at line 94; with no key matching `fixture@example.invalid`, the commit fails and every `DeployTests` case errors in `setUp()`. Adding repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit is a small hermetic-test fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
